items.subject: mRNA-1273-P101
items.supporting_quote: Phase 1 First-in-Human (mRNA-1273-P101), a Phase 1 clinical trial

items.subject: mRNA-1273-P101
items.statement: Two doses of 100 mcg (0.5 mL IM injection) administered on Day 1 and Day 29
items.supporting_quote:
Dosing Schedule: Two doses (Day 1 and Day 29)
Dose: 100 mcg (0.5 mL IM injection)

items.subject: mRNA-1273-P101
items.statement: COVID-19 ≥14 days post-dose 2 with vaccine efficacy of 96.2% (95% CI: 93.2%, 97.2%), p-value < 0.0001

items.subject: mRNA-1273-P101
items.statement: Injection site pain (95%), fatigue (77%), headache (64%), and myalgia (63%), majority mild to moderate and resolved within 1-3 days
items.supporting_quote: The most common solicited adverse events were injection site pain (95%), fatigue (77%), headache (64%), and myalgia (63%). The majority of adverse events were mild to moderate and resolved within 1-3 days.

items.subject: mRNA-1273-P101
items.statement: Serious adverse events occurred in 1.6% of vaccine recipients vs 1.5% of placebo recipients; no vaccine-related SAEs led to death
items.supporting_quote: Serious adverse events (SAEs) occurred in 1.6% of vaccine recipients vs 1.5% of placebo recipients. No vaccine-related SAEs led to death.

items.subject: mRNA-1273-P101
items.statement: Seroconversion rates were 99.2% at 28 days post-dose 2 with geometric mean titers (GMTs) at Day 57 of 1107 (95% CI: 785 – 1883)
items.supporting_quote: Geometric mean titers (GMTs) at Day 57 were 1107 (95% CI: 785 – 1883). Seroconversion rates were 99.2% at 28 days post-dose 2.
